document:661.text:
(Much of the writing has been weathered by the sea breeze, but the operating instructions are still clear.)
Follow these steps exactly when operating the fire room valve:
First, fit the <style="highlight">custom gear</style> into the slot. Wait until it clicks into place before proceeding.
Next, turn the valve wheel <style="highlight">clockwise</style> until it stops. This will close the inner gate.
Finally, turn the wheel <style="highlight">counterclockwise</style> until you hear air flowing in. Wait for the hissing to stop. Once the pressure has equalized, the door is safe to open.
document:661.source_cn:
（这篇交接事项的字迹受海风侵蚀有些模糊，但操作说明依然可辨）
为确保安全，启动锅炉房阀门时，必须严格遵循以下步骤：
首先，将<style="highlight">特制齿轮</style>嵌入凹糟内，听到“咔哒”一声后再进行下一步操作；
接着，<style="highlight">顺时针旋转</style>阀门手轮，直至无法转动，确保内部闸门闭合；
最后，<style="highlight">逆时针旋转</style>阀门手轮，直至听到气流注入声，以锁定压力平衡。等待气流声停止，即可开门。

say:2:1821442003:1.text: This must be Sharu. But if he came here to shut down the engines, what caused them to explode?
